name: Map101/Crate/page1
code: pbMessage("Bottles wrapped in straw. Maku carries them as carefully as he can.")

name: Map101/Crate spare/page1
code: pbMessage("One of the boxes Maku is helping Mother put away.")

name: Map101/Seller at home/page1
code: pbMessage("Seller: Your mother has a better head for keys than I do.")

name: Map102/Oil shop sign/page1
code:
pbMessage("LAMP OIL. Please ask the seller for assistance.
A small bottle hangs beside the lettering.")

name: Map102/Empty house/page1
code: pbMessage("The door has swollen in its frame. Nobody answers.")

name: Map102/Seated neighbour/page1
code:
pbMessage("Young as ever, aren't you? I wish I knew your secret.")
pbMessage("Your mother still lights the tower every night. I used to complain that it shone through my curtains.")

name: Map102/Tide bell/page1
code: pbMessage("A bell with no clapper. Salt has filled the inscription.")

name: Map102/Headland flowers/page1
code:
pbMessage("Late flowers, sheltered by a ring of flat stones.
Someone has tied the weakest stems to little sticks.")

name: Map102/Sea glass/page1
code:
pbMessage("Green glass, worn smooth by the water.
For a moment, it catches the light.")

name: Map102/Coast lamp:home/page1
code:
pbMessage("Mother lights this little lamp before dusk.
So you can always find the path home.")

name: Map102/Coast lamp:pier/page1
code: pbMessage("A little oil lamp. Someone still tends it, even with the boats gone.")

name: Map102/Mooring rope/page1
code: pbMessage("An old mooring rope disappears beneath the boards.")

name: Map102/Coast road sign/page1
code: pbMessage("COAST ROAD - SOUTH. The lettering has been repainted around the rusted nails.")

name: Map102/Coast lamp:shop/page1
code: pbMessage("A sheltered flame warms the shopfront.")

name: Map103/White flowers/page1
code: pbMessage("Small white flowers. They have survived the cold.")

name: Map104/Downward lamp/page1
code:
pbMessage("A smaller lamp points straight down into the water.
The glass is warm.")

name: Map106/Bottles/page1
code: pbMessage("Old glass, washed and washed again. Each bottle has a different name scratched underneath.")

name: Map106/Old ledger/page1
code:
pbMessage("The ledger lies open to a page with very few names.
Your mother's is underlined.")

name: Map108/Southern steps/page1
code: pbMessage("A narrow trail bends down to a pond. Fishing lines hang motionless over the water.")

name: Map108/Torn wrapping/page1
code: pbMessage("Straw packing, and an empty oil-shop bag. They came this way.")

name: Map108/Shore flowers/page1
code: pbMessage("Small flowers turn away from the salt wind.")

name: Map108/Coast lamp:storehouse/page1
code: pbMessage("The wick has been trimmed recently.")

name: Map108/Pond obelisk (Surf)/page1
code: pbMessage("A narrow stone, cold beneath your hand. Water has worn the marks too shallow to read.")

name: Map108/Old fishing basket/page1
code: pbMessage("A basket repaired with three different kinds of twine. A tiny fish has been carved into the handle.")

name: Map109/Unwashed dishes/page1
code: pbMessage("Bowls in the washbasin. Someone has washed one spoon and given up.")

code: pbMessage("Oil tins and spare glass, wrapped carefully against the damp.")

name: Map110/Coast lamp:cellar/page1

name: Map111/Seller at vault/page1
code: pbMessage("Seller: Tell them I sent you. It will not get you a discount. Entry is free.")

name: Map111/Necklace drawer/page1
code: pbMessage("A shallow drawer, now locked. The seller's necklace rests inside, wrapped in cloth.")

name: Map111/Empty bays/page1
code: pbMessage("Numbered shelves. Most are empty. There is space here for much more than one household could need.")

name: Map111/Cabinet locks/page1
code: pbMessage("Small brass locks. Mother has kept the keys.")

name: Map111/Old masonry/page1
code: pbMessage("The lowest stones are darker than the rest. The mortar has been renewed around them.")

name: Map112/Museum sign/page1
code: pbMessage("DOCKSIDE MUSEUM. Objects from the coast. Admission free. Please wipe your shoes.")

code: pbMessage("Freight labels lie beneath newer freight labels. Most of the names have blurred in the salt air.")

code: pbMessage("Porter: Mind the ropes. We have enough things falling into the water.")

code: pbMessage("Net mender: They bring torn nets here from every little village along the coast. Some come back with the same knot I tied last year.")

name: Map112/Warehouse notice/page1
code: pbMessage("Deliveries by arrangement. No loose goods accepted without a name and a count.")

name: Map112/Closed quay/page1
code: pbMessage("A chain closes the far quay. Work lamps glow beyond it.")

name: Map112/Dock frontage/page1
code: pbMessage('SAIL REPAIRS. A needle taps against a thimble behind the door.')

name: Map112/Dock frontage/page1
code: pbMessage('Rooms above the quay. Someone has left boots drying inside.')

name: Map112/Dock frontage/page1
code: pbMessage('CUSTOMS STORE. Sealed cargo awaiting a count.')

code: pbMessage("A chandler's window. Rope, wax and spare wicks, arranged with great care.")

name: Map112/Dock frontage/page1
code: pbMessage('The bakery has closed. The smell of bread lingers in the doorway.')

code: pbMessage("An empty fish stall. The boards have been scrubbed clean.")

name: Map112/Quay worker/page1
code: pbMessage("Worker: The small boats still call. Oil out, torn nets back. There is always something to mend.")

name: Map112/Dock resident/page1
code: pbMessage("Resident: The windows stay lit so the crews can find the quay. Even when nobody is expected.")

code: pbMessage("The Salt Thread. Its hull smells of pine tar. A cargo list promises flour, hinges and letters.")

name: Map112/Demo prop:ship2/page1
code: pbMessage("The Little Promise. Fresh rope and carefully mended sails. A little duck is carved into the tiller.")

name: Map112/Demo prop:cargo/page1
code: pbMessage("Crates of lamp oil and flour. The destination is written twice: PSYDUCK ISLAND.")

code: pbMessage("NEXT WATCH: The Little Promise, Psyduck Island. Passengers: ask the captain on the eastern pier.")

name: Map112/Demo prop:ledger/page1
code: pbMessage("Flour: twelve sacks. Oil: six tins. Letters: one sealed box. Paid in full, except for the letters.")

name: Map112/Demo prop:memorial/page1
code: pbMessage("A low stone bears names worn shallow by hands. Fresh knots of ribbon hang from the rail beside it.")

name: Map113/Attendant/page1
code:
pbMessage("Attendant: Welcome. Take your time. If you have come for the sabre, it is in the middle case.")
pbMessage("Attendant: People ask who made it. I would rather leave the label unfinished than put a guess on it.")

name: Map113/Museum case:Harbour bell/page1
code: pbMessage("A cracked harbour bell. The label lists the names of the people who paid to recast it.")

name: Map113/Museum case:Sounding weights/page1
code: pbMessage("Lead sounding weights and a carefully knotted line. An old way of learning how much water lies beneath a boat.")

name: Map113/Museum case:Ceramic fragments/page1
code: pbMessage("Fragments of bowls and plates from coastal households. Familiar blue reeds curve across one piece.")

name: Map113/Museum case:Shipping ledger/page1
code: pbMessage("A shipping ledger, open to a page of ordinary deliveries: lamp oil, flour, cloth.")

name: Map113/Visitor/page1
code: pbMessage("Visitor: I came in to get out of the wind. That was a while ago.")
